## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vitakkattika* (Patthana 19.6) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka. In the overall structural organization of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the *vitakka-ttika* ("The Triad 'Thought-conception, etc.'") stands as the sixth triad among the twenty-two primary matrix triads (*tika*) used to analyze conditional relations [Nyanatiloka 2007].
